'''Aucfans''' were small [[Rodent/Legends|rodent-like]] creatures considered to be vermin. They had green skin, two large sharp ears and two red eyes. These creatures sometimes entered into cargo containers of [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] or warehouses and had troubled the employees.<ref name="ST" />

==Behind the scenes==
This creature appeared as a ''baby aucfan'' in the monitor screen through which a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Unidentified Star Tours droid supervisor|supervisor]] talked with [[R2-D7]] at the [[Tokyo Disneyland]] [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']].<ref name="ST" />
